offer.paragraph: verifiable-autonomy is a Claude-Code-hosted multi-agent system where every agent ships with verifiability built in: Surface-Compliance discipline (verbatim citation required, refusal on thin substrate), pre-registered falsifiers you grep against the audit log, append-only JSONL of every action with cited sources, operator-supervised by default. Runs in your Claude Code on your machine with your API key.
